page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g6.4xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated vCPUs mapped from 8 physical Intel Xeon 8269CY cores running at 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The system is equipped with 64.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of memory per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying entirely on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 5 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks place the ecs.g6.4xlarge primarily in the average tier for multi-core and memory operations. While single-core performance is relatively weak, as evidenced by stress-ng single-core CPU and single-threaded gzip compression scores in the bottom 25%, its multi-core capabilities are more robust. The instance achieves average ratings in Geekbench multi-core tests, Passmark CPU scores, and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression. Memory bandwidth is also stable, with read-only small block cached speeds reaching 779.61 GB/sec and large block uncached write speeds at 46.34 GB/sec.

Given its balanced resource allocation and average multi-core performance, the ecs.g6.4xlarge offers a cost-efficient profile for standard enterprise workloads that do not require specialized hardware accelerators or high-speed local NVMe storage. It is well-suited for general-purpose applications such as static web serving, where it demonstrates an average throughput of 11.32 GB/sec, database operations, and software compilation.
